title: State Prices for Gas: A $4-Plus Average, but Some States See Relief
description:
State prices for gas matter to your budget: Forbes reported an average above $4 per gallon on October 6, 2026, putting a hypothetical 15-gallon purchase above $60 at that average. Newsweek’s October 5 report identifies falling prices in states suspending fuel taxes, although the supplied evidence does not establish how much those suspensions explain.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
